sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 173 was established by Ordinance No. 18221, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 11, 1984. Ordinance No. 18221 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 18221 was amended by Ordinance No. 20890, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 27, 1991; Ordinance No. 22106, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 22, 1994; Ordinance No. 22795, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 26, 1996; and Ordinance No. 23276, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18221; 20890; 22106; 22795; 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 173 is established on property generally located on the northeast corner of Frankford Road and Hillcrest Road. The size of PD 173 is approximately 95.64 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18221; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. The conceptual plan (Exhibit 173A), consists of a conceptual plan approved by the city plan commission for PD 173, with modifications to the conceptual plan for Tract C-1 approved by city council. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Detailed Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.105.DETAILED DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)Within six months of the date of passage of Ordinance No. 18221, a detailed development plan for either the Property or a designated first phase of development must be submitted to the city plan commission for approval prior to the issuance of a building permit for the Property. The detailed development plan must comply with the approved conceptual plan and this article. If a development plan is submitted for a designated first phase of development only, a subsequent development plan is required for each subsequent phase of development. Each subsequent development plan must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for that phase of development.
(b)City council-approved development plans for Tracts D/E, F, and F-1 are labelled Exhibits 173B, 173C, and 173D.
(c)For a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses, development and use of Tract C-1 must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 173F). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.
(d)If no building permit has been issued for a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses use within Tract C-1, a development plan may be submitted to the city plan commission for consideration as if it was the original development plan for Tract C-1, and it will not be considered an amendment to any development plan for a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes, and hospice uses.
(e)The owner of Tract C-1 must notify the president of the North Dallas Neighborhood Alliance (the “Alliance”) of any zoning changes, development plans or development plan amendments, landscape plan amendments, and amendments to public deed restrictions affecting Tract C-1. Notice must be sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, at the same time any application for such a change is filed with the city, to the address on file with the city for the Alliance. Mailing of the notice to that address shall be deemed to be compliance with this requirement, whether or not the notice is received by the Alliance. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 22795; 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.106.PERMITTED USES. The permitted uses on each tract are as follows:
(1)Tract A. All uses permitted in an R-7.5 Single-Family District.
(2)Tract B. Public park or playground only.
(3)Tract C. All uses permitted in a TH-1 Townhouse District.
(4)Tract C-1.
(A)All uses permitted in the TH-1 Townhouse District.
(B)Hospital use. [Use of any emergency rooms and surgical suites are limited to patients who are already residents of the hospital and/or convalescent and nursing homes and related institutions use.]
(C)Convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions. [This use is limited to convalescent and nursing homes, and hospice care uses. Related institutions are prohibited. This use will be referred to as convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses.]
(5)Tract D/E. All uses permitted in a TH-2 Townhouse District, private recreation club or area uses, and private streets and alleys.
(6)Tract F. All uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District, except that multiple-family uses are prohibited.
(7)Tract F-1. Health studio, animal clinic without outside runs, and all uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District, except that multiple-family uses are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Accessory Guard House Use
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.107.ACCESSORY GUARD HOUSE USE. A guard house for traffic control is permitted as an accessory use, provided the guard house is located on a private street. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Private Streets And Alleys
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.108.PRIVATE STREETS AND ALLEYS. Private streets and alleys are permitted within Tract D/E. Private streets and alleys must comply with Article VIII. Private streets may serve no more than 162 lots. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.109.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. Development of each tract must comply with the development standards applicable to the zoning districts indicated below:
(1)Tracts A and B. R-7.5 Single-Family District.
(2)Tract C. TH-1 Townhouse District.
(3)Tract C-1.
(A)For a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses, the following development standards apply:
(i)Front yard. Minimum front yard is 25 feet.
(ii)Side and rear yards. Minimum side and rear yards are 15 feet.
(iii)Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.
(iv)Lighting standards. Parking lot lights, not to exceed 20 feet in height, and all other outdoor lighting exceeding six feet in height, must be fitted with a shield-type directional fixture to direct light onto the Property and away from adjacent properties. The lighting along the southern property line must be ground lighting located at the base of the wall along the southern boundary line and must direct light away from the adjacent properties to the south.
(v)Landscaping/screening.
(a)Landscaping and screening must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 173G). Landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. A solid screening fence along the eastern and northern boundary lines is permitted up to a maximum height of eight feet.
(vi)Additional provisions.
(aa) Kitchen venting. All exterior cooking vent-hoods related to the kitchen facilities must have scrubbers and must be placed on the northern portion of the roof ridge. The airflow from the kitchen venting must be directed away from the southern Property line.
(bb) Parking. Parking must be provided in the amount and in the location shown on the development plan. At all times that construction of any structure is ongoing on the Property, all construction workers must be provided with an all weather parking surface on the Property, and the parking area must be on a compacted sub-grade and must consist of concrete paving, hot mix asphalt paving consisting of a binder and surface course, or a material which has equivalent characteristics and has the approval of the building official.
(B)For all other uses within Tract C-1, the TH-1 Townhouse District regulations apply.
(4)Tract D/E. TH-2 Townhouse District.
(5)Tract F. NS Neighborhood Service District.
(6)Tract F-1.Unless otherwise provided for in this article, NS Neighborhood Service District. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.110.DENSITY.
(a)Maximum number of dwelling units permitted on each tract is 98 units on Tract A, 128 units on Tract C and C-1 together, with a maximum of 15 units on Tract C-1, and 311 units on Tract D/E. The density on Tracts F and F-1 is controlled solely by the development standards applicable to those tracts.
(b)Within Tract C-1, for all hospital uses and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses combined, the maximum number of permitted beds is 121, with no more than 43 of those beds permitted as “hospital use beds.” “Hospital use bed” means a bed adjacent to built-in monitoring and life safety equipment such as outlets for oxygen. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Development Schedule
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.111.DEVELOPMENT SCHEDULE. Until January 1, 1986, no uses are permitted on Tract F, and no more than 290 dwelling units may be occupied on the entire Property. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.112.FLOOR AREA RATIO.
(a)Maximum permitted floor area ratio on Tract F-1 is 0.5 to 1.0.
(b)Maximum permitted floor area ratio on Tract C-1 is 1.0. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.113.MAXIMUM HEIGHT.
(a)All buildings and structures on the Property must have two or less stories. The height of buildings and structures must not exceed 36 feet in Tracts C and D/E, and 24 feet in Tracts A, B, F, and F-1.
(b)Tract C-1.
(1)For a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses, maximum height is 36 feet, with no building to exceed two stories. That portion of the building identified as “single story” as shown on the development plan for Tract C-1 may not exceed one story. No portion of a structure for a hospital use and/or convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses in Tract C-1 may exceed 46 feet in height.
(2)For all other uses, the height of buildings and structures must not exceed 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822; 25822)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.114.SIGNS.
(a)Except as otherwise provided in Subsections (b) and (c), all signs on the Property must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.”
(b)For all hospital uses and/or a convalescent and nursing homes and hospice care uses combined within Tract C-1, a maximum of one detached premise sign is permitted, subject to the following restrictions: it must be a monument sign; it is permitted only on the property fronting on Hillcrest Road in the area shown on the development plan for Tract C-1; and it may not exceed eight feet in width or six feet in height from grade.
(c)All signs on Tracts F and F-1 must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations,” with the following exceptions:
(1)Maximum height of any detached sign is 24 feet.
(2)Maximum effective area per detached sign is 100 square feet.
(3)No non-premise signs are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 23276; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Road Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-173.115.ROAD IMPROVEMENTS. Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for the guard house:
(1)A 100-foot stacking lane must be provided on the Property on the north side of Frankford Road at the entrance to Tract D/E, as shown on the paving improvements plan (Exhibit 173E).
(2)A 100-foot storage pocket at the left turn lane on eastbound Frankford Road at the entrance to Tract D/E must be provided as shown on the paving improvements plan. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.116.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.117.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22106; 25508; 25822; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-173.118.ZONING MAP. PD 173 is located on Zoning Map Nos. AA-7 and AA-8. (Ord. Nos. 18221; 25508; 25822)
